resources.string: Plays the new-message effect over the lock screen and hides the system bars while the LED turns the screen on.

When a new message lights the lock screen, this service draws your chosen glow effect over it for two seconds; the lock screen stays visible and usable underneath. When the LED lights the screen, it also covers the battery icon and navigation handle with black for half a second. It reads no screen content and receives no accessibility events.
Briefly used to light the screen when a message arrives. Dismissed automatically.
A new message plays this effect in the app\'s colour. Afterwards the screen goes black and only the LED dot blinks, cycling through each waiting app\'s colour, until you read or dismiss the messages.
The lock screen lights up with all your notifications and the effect plays over it. Needs Effects & clean wake turned on; without it the lock screen just lights up.
The screen comes on black and only the effect plays, then the dot.
The screen comes on black, the effect plays and the phone pops up only the new message, in its own notification style, then the dot. Your lock-screen privacy settings decide how much of it shows.
Lets Ambient Glow notice new messages to light the screen and pick each app\'s colour. It never reads, stores or sends message content.
A silent, self-dismissing alert is how Android lets an app light the screen from the background. It needs high importance.
Android 14+ asks you to confirm that Ambient Glow may turn the display on.

Needed to play the new-message effect over your lock screen; without it the lock screen just lights up. It also covers the battery icon and navigation handle with black for the half second the LED takes over. It reads nothing on screen.

Only these pixels light up; the rest of the panel stays black. Drag it on the preview or use the sliders; it snaps to the spots below and the ruler marks. Camera-line spots sit level with the centre of your lens.
Dot position preview. Drag to move.
Lock the screen now. The test message arrives when the count reaches zero.
Allow alerts on the Access tab first.
Shows the new message again as a pop-up when the black screen comes on. Silent; removed after a few seconds.
Sample message sent by the locked-screen test.
Dismiss me and cyan leaves the LED loop.
Dismiss me and magenta leaves the loop. Dismiss both and the LED stops.
